responsibility: This definition module declares direct C bindings for a wide range of compiler-builtin-compatible functions and libc-style memory/string primitives. It belongs to the gm2 low-level C interop layer and exports math routines across SHORTREAL/REAL/LONGREAL and complex types, finiteness and infinity tests, alloca and memcpy-family helpers, and common C string search and manipulation functions, providing the callable fallback and foreign-function surface used by Builtins and the precision-specific math modules when GCC intrinsic expansion is not enough.
